title: Modern Swift Concurrency
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of modern swift concurrency in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 13: Modern Swift Concurrency. Lessons in order: Introduction to Concurrency; Asynchronous Functions with async and await; Async Error Handling; Tasks and Task Lifetimes; Structured Concurrency; Task Groups; Task Cancellation; Actors; The Main Actor; Sendable and Data-Race Safety; Isolation and Nonisolated Declarations; Tasks, Priorities, and Scheduling; Concurrent Sequences and Async Streams; Advanced Concurrency Design.
